about: The six credential schemas that replaced their placeholder identifiers (ADR-045, amendment of 2026-11-05). accepted: the published file (in contracts/credential-schemas), with the identifier it must digest to: the Blake3-256 of the document with $id replaced by 44 '#', as a CESR 'E' code. refused: documents that must not be accepted as the schema named. Checked independently by contracts/check_credential_schema_vectors.py.

refused.name: a widened schema under the real identifier
refused.why: the guardianship schema with its required claims removed no longer digests to the identifier it carries

refused.name: a schema asked for by the wrong identifier
refused.why: a genuine Proof of Age schema is not the Guardianship schema, so it is refused when that is what was asked for
